rules.title: Intake before writing
rules.harness: ad_brief.json already is the intake (hook, audience, objections, CTA, traffic implied by the ad). The skill's extra questions (ICP, three objections, proof assets) map onto ad_brief + facts_pack; do not add a second intake interview. Documented on the landing-style cartridges.

rules.title: Page structure (hero / argument / objections)
rules.harness: Each cartridge already has a required section order. Longform is the closest match (hero, problem, how-it-works, proof, FAQ, CTA). Product-page is the high-intent short form. Article keeps its editorial warm-up and does not take this skeleton.

rules.title: Layout type A/B/C/D
rules.harness: Already encoded as cartridges: A classic ≈ product-page, B long-form story ≈ longform + article, C minimal ≈ listicle close, D comparison = comparison cartridge. No new cartridge.

rules.title: One primary CTA; no competing CTAs above the fold
rules.harness: Already a hard gate. The skill restates it; we do not add a second check.

rules.title: CTA is a verb plus the outcome; never Learn more / Submit
rules.harness: Soft warning. Cartridges already allowlist CTA phrases; this catches a writer who still emits a banned generic on a cartridge without an allowlist.

rules.title: At least one risk reversal (trial, cancel, money-back)
rules.harness: Layout only: the risk-reversal block. Copy must be a verified claim. Money-back / 30-day guarantee / white-glove framing is a tenant-locked decline -- a tenant that does not offer those cannot print them. The comparison cartridge already has an optional risk_reversal field.

rules.title: Headline formulas and benefit-first bullets
rules.harness: Prompt wording on landing-style cartridges. The article cartridge keeps its own 8-14 word curiosity formula. Not a gate -- headline shape is already a soft check for article.

rules.title: Build section by section
rules.harness: The writer emits one page.json per cartridge. Section-by-section generation would be a pipeline change outside this component.

rules.title: SEO / AEO / noindex for ad-only pages
rules.harness: Index vs noindex is a publish-time decision, not a writer one. JSON-LD already ships. Do not silently noindex.

rules.title: Pitfalls list
rules.harness: Covered piecewise: one CTA (gate), vague verbs (soft), proof next to the claim (article/listicle soft proof-in-section), mobile (block gate 390 px).

rules.title: Geist / Manrope only; no Inter / italic / ultra-bold
rules.harness: The tenant's brand tokens own type. The engine never hard-codes a font family.

rules.title: No hyphens in copy
rules.harness: Would reject legitimate product names, claim ids' rendered sentences, and standard English compounds. Not a harness rule.

rules.title: text-wrap balance / pretty
rules.harness: Optional CSS on new blocks. Not enforced on existing structure.css (a behavior-preserving commit would not restyle every page).

rules.title: Snap every font-size to the Tailwind scale
rules.harness: The harness is not a Tailwind app. Sizes resolve through rem + CSS variables.

rules.title: Spacing token table
rules.harness: Existing blocks already use a small px set; forcing a new token table would restyle every block and break visual parity.

rules.title: Nested radius formula
rules.harness: Not statically checkable in block.css without a layout engine. Documented as a manual review note in the design-audit agent.

rules.title: No single-sided card borders
rules.harness: Applied to the feature-grid block (it had a border-top only). Existing structure.css rules are left alone.

rules.title: No background gradients; flat surfaces
rules.check: existing:blocks.gate (no hardcoded colors) + no linear-gradient in new blocks
rules.harness: New blocks ship flat. The block gate already forbids color literals.

rules.title: Dark-mode hex palette
rules.harness: Conflicts with the block gate (CSS variables only) and with tenant brand tokens.

rules.title: Hero heading is a left-to-right text gradient
rules.harness: A gradient fill needs color literals; the block gate forbids them. Tenant type color stays a CSS variable.

rules.title: Hero heading/subhead max-width 680px
rules.harness: Conflicts with the block gate's 390 px fixed-width ceiling. Use max-width: 100%.

rules.title: Icon libraries (Phosphor / Solar / Iconamoon)
rules.harness: Blocks do not ship icon fonts. Proof is claims and photos.

rules.title: IntersectionObserver word-reveals; custom cubic-bezier; no window scroll
rules.harness: Blocks cannot contain scripts (block gate). Host-page scroll observers already exist on listicle. New blocks may use CSS-only motion with the skill's cubic-bezier.

rules.title: No Lorem Ipsum, John Doe, Acme Corp, SmartFlow
rules.harness: Hard gate. Planted-bad pages fail; known-good pages pass.

rules.title: No Seamless / Next Gen / Delve / Tapestry / In the world of
rules.harness: Hard gate for the skill's cliches that are not already in the tenant hype list (elevate / unleash / game-changer stay tenant vocab so the existing synonym repair still owns them).

rules.title: No round fake numbers (99.99%, $100.00)
rules.harness: A number on a page already needs a claim_id. Invented-roundness is not separately measurable without false-positing real prices.

rules.title: No dead '#' links
rules.harness: Hard gate. A same-page '#faq' is fine; a bare '#' or javascript: url is not. The existing internal-link check treated '#' as internal -- this one is stricter on the dead form only.

rules.title: Hover / active / focus / loading / empty / error states
rules.harness: Advertorials are not app UI. Focus rings live on the tenant's base.css when they exist. No form chrome on these pages.

rules.title: Ship list (404, legal, skip-link, favicon, alt, semantic HTML)
rules.harness: Alt text is renderer-derived from the asset library (already). Semantic HTML is already in the templates. 404 / cookie / skip-link are storefront concerns, not a generated advertorial.

rules.title: Mandatory tagline-reveal section
rules.harness: New tagline-reveal block (layout only, CSS motion, no per-word JS). Optional on landing-style cartridges; soft warning when the field is absent. Never required on article (would name the offer inside the warm-up window).
